assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - change assurance not applied to P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4103, M-4103 and PT-4103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically inspecting Ex equipment and enclosures. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 9 August 2025 a planned assurance activity of P-4103, M-4103 and PT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip not effective.
